scope: Arithmetic and analytic reasoning from authenticated prior selected-patch report only; no original geometry, selection, UV, candidate unwrap, tests or renderer executed.

unconditional_for_required_nonoverlappin.derivation: For each original 3D triangle, both singular values of its world-tangent-to-texel Jacobian must be at least4096, so its UV area is at least original 3D area times4096 squared. Sum over all4531 preserved triangles; no positive-area UV overlap allows the sum to be compared with atlas area.

source_connected_chart_count_bound.assumptions: Each UV chart is source-edge-connected and may not bridge original edge-components. Mere shared vertex connectivity does not join source-edge components.
source_connected_chart_count_bound.explanation: Cuts required at nonmanifold edges may leave face sets connected by other paths, so219 is not a justified count of extra required charts.

conditional_prior_owner_policy.policy: Reuse previous conservative32-aligned owner rectangle dimension rule with at least64 by64 texels per positive-area chart. This minimum is policy-specific; exact CLAMP ancestry can have atlas-edge cases.

overhead_reporting: After actual candidate UVs, report sum(owner rectangle areas) minus sum(nonoverlapping actual UV triangle areas). Prior64 by64 rectangle area already contains content: neither adding the full owner floor to the density area floor nor subtracting those two independent floors proves a universal overhead.
